name: Air Hockey Cup 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Air Hockey Cup is an addictive sports title that plays like a classic table hockey game, where your aim is key, and mastering your puck control can make or break your game.How to Play Air Hockey CupThe game's objective is to get the puck into the opponent's goal, but to get there, you'll need to position the puck so you can pass, shoot, and block one turn at a time.
